description: Atlyn Gantt Chart brings timeline and roadmap storytelling into Power BI. Display tasks, phases, or campaigns as horizontal bars positioned by start and end dates, with progress fill, category colors, and a configurable today-line indicator, all embedded directly inside analytical reports. Key features: - Task bars driven by start date, end date, and percent-complete - Category coloring, milestone styling, and a today marker - Scrollable rows with sticky header for long plans - Rich hover tooltips and data labels - Formatting pane control over colors, bar height, and grid; high-contrast and theme aware; keyboard accessible Common uses: marketing and content calendars, project and delivery plans, product launch timelines, operational roadmaps, and campaign schedules. Interactivity: select a task to cross-filter related visuals, hover for details, and right-click for the standard context menu. The included sample report demonstrates a complete timeline scenario with formatting and interactive report context, plus usage tips. Licensing: This visual is free to download and evaluate from Microsoft AppSource. Continued commercial use requires a paid AtlynCo subscription after a 30-day free trial. See https://www.atlynco.com/pricing for plans and pricing. Microsoft does not manage licensing or billing for this visual; subscriptions are handled independently by AtlynCo.
